founderBody: Fitliner didn’t start as a feature list in an office. It grew out of everyday gym life: payments, memberships and doors that needed opening. Now it helps other owners handle those same tasks.
faq: Do I have to replace my existing access system?
No. Fitliner connects in parallel with any system you already use. Existing fobs, cards or the turnstile remain fully functional.
Do I have to remove reception?
No. Keep your reception. Fitliner can handle routine tasks and complement the way you already operate.
No. You choose your opening hours. Round-the-clock access is an option, not a requirement.
A qualified electrician or technician, using the supplied diagram. We can help remotely if needed.
What if I don’t know which system I use?
That’s fine. Fitliner connects in parallel with the existing system. The module only needs 12 V power and a position within 5 metres of the door or turnstile.
What do I get for a one-time €297 payment?

A Fitliner chip for your door or turnstile, a wiring diagram, instructions and support. EU delivery is included. Owners and clients get free lifetime access to the Fitliner app with no monthly subscription.
Download the app to create your gym and connect your payment gateway. The module arrives within 7 business days and your electrician installs it using the supplied diagram.
Does Fitliner need internet at the gym?
No. The Fitliner module is designed to work reliably offline. You do not need data cabling, and an internet outage does not stop members from entering.
Yes. Fitliner connects in parallel with the turnstile. The module only needs 12 V power and a position within 5 metres of the entrance.
